subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

What will you do in case of __not being selected__ for this job?
solution:
The correct answer is '**No substitution required**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given above sentence is grammatically correct.
 
• The given above sentence is in the form of a perfect passive gerund.
 
• As per the general rule, to make a **gerund perfect** (**put it in past tense**), an** auxiliary verb with -ing is followed by a past participle**.
 
• The auxiliary verb is **"be" + -ing** for **passive construction**.
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• *We went through the safari park without **being seen** by the lions. (correct)*
 
• *We went through the safari park without **having seen** by the lions. (incorrect)*
 
 
 
• *​*Here, in the given above sentence, '**not being selected**' is used in perfect passive gerund format, which is correct according to the rule.
 
• ​According to the explanation and example that are given above, there is **No substitution required** for the underlined segment.​​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• As per the general rule, the auxiliary verb is **"have" + -ing** for **active construction**.
 
• **Example: **
 
 
• ***​**I enjoyed **having **eaten that cake. (correct)*
 
• *I enjoyed **being **eaten that cake. (incorrect)*
